title: ARMS & GENTLE CORE
subtitle: FRIDAY EASE. SOFT ARMS. KIND CORE.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Friday is soft arms and a gentle core — a small break from the desk, nothing fierce. About eleven minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Soft arms, a kind core, and you showed up. Enjoy your day — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair. Soft belly. Light hand weights optional — empty hands are fine. Start with hands at about shoulder height and press gently upward only as high as feels kind, then lower with control. Soft on the shoulders and neck. Smaller range is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead press. Two sets of six. Sit tall, soft belly, press gently upward only as high as feels kind, then lower. Empty hands are fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the shoulders.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair. Soft belly. Elbows soft at your sides. Draw the elbows gently back as if squeezing a soft cushion between the shoulder blades, then ease forward. Light weights optional. Keep the neck soft. Smaller squeeze is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Two sets of eight. Sit tall, soft belly, draw the elbows gently back, then ease forward. Soft on the neck.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the upper back.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Lift one knee a little, then lower with control. Alternate sides like a gentle march. Keep the range small and kind. Hold the chair lightly if you like. Smaller lift is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts. Two sets of six each leg. Sit tall, soft belly, lift one knee a little, then lower. Keep it small and kind.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Easy breath. Soften the hips.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Hinge gently from the hips and reach the hands forward toward the floor or your shins — only as far as feels kind. Soft neck, easy breath. Hold about twenty seconds, then stack tall again. Smaller reach is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach. Two holds of about twenty seconds. Soft belly, hinge gently from the hips, reach only as far as feels kind. Soft neck.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the back. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Forward reach done. That's the session — lovely work.
